opti-1: A dark, still swamp. Something is watching.
opti-2: An alligator's eyes and nose sit right on top of its head.
opti-3: On pale sand, a scrub lizard nearly disappears.
opti-4: A panther kitten is born with spots. They fade as it grows.
opti-5: How do Florida animals survive in such a wild, watery world?
30-01-welcome: Our film starts in a dark Florida swamp where something is watching. First, inspect a mysterious skull.
30-01-lesson: Today you're a biologist. Follow manatees through winter, test which animal hides where, then open the Classification Cabinet.
30-01-check: Three quick questions. It's not graded. It's just for you, so give each one your best try.
30-01-assign: Time to show what you learned. Match the adaptations, then draw a Florida animal in its home.
how-30-01-specimen: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the skull, then tap three things you notice.
how-30-01-compare: Put the green leaf under one tray and the pale sand under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap.
how-30-01-wall: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing step: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the photo shows.
how-30-01-det: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap an adaptation you see, then name its animal group. Predict where it lives, and watch its habitat appear.
how-30-01-partc: Pick any Florida animal from this lesson. Draw it in its habitat and label two adaptations. For each label, name the feature and how it helps.
